description: This source file defines a controller class for managing IP-based fraud detection within the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for listing, adding, removing, and managing IP addresses associated with fraud detection, as well as installing, uninstalling, and updating settings related to IP fraud checks.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class for managing IP-based fraud detection in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main IP fraud management page, including breadcrumb setup and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the IP fraud extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation procedures for the IP fraud extension, including setting up the necessary model.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation procedures for the IP fraud extension, including removing configuration via the model.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Displays a list of IP addresses flagged for fraud, with pagination.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the fraud detection list after validation.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the fraud detection list.
